description: Tests CI does not run, each with the reason. Entries without 'platforms' read the owner's machine or private overlay and are skipped on every runner; entries with 'platforms' exercise a Windows-host feature and are skipped only on the listed operating systems. Used only by Run-AllTests.ps1 -SkipListPath; local runs execute everything.

skip.reason: Probes the installed host CLIs (copilot, grok, cursor, code-insiders, ...) with --version; CI runners have none of them.
One assertion reads the mobile catalog deployed into the live user profile, which only exists after sync --apply on the owner's machine.
Scans the owner's local fleet clone root and requires the mobile-scope section that lives in the private overlay policy.
Requires the fleet-wide repository boundary from the private overlay policy (overlays/personal/global-agent-policy.md).
Requires the private overlay package overlays/personal/packages/sarosh-audio-voice and the overlay policy.
Requires the private overlay package overlays/personal/packages/sarosh-communication and the overlay policy.
Requires the private overlay package overlays/personal/packages/sarosh-writing and the overlay policy.
One case launches a Copilot child through the owner's gh account; a CI runner has no such account.
Checks that each host executable in registry/agents.json resolves on this machine; CI runners have none of the agents installed.
Checks declared host paths against the live user profile, which on a CI runner has no deployed host config.
Compares registry MCP declarations with each host's deployed config in the live user profile.
Requires media-studio skills and plugin caches deployed into the live user profile.
Reads the installed plugin caches in the live user profile.
Reads the deployed ~/.claude/settings.json.
Examines MCP entries in the deployed host configs of the live user profile.
Reads the deployed OpenCode config in the live user profile.
Reads the deployed Codex and Grok configs in the live user profile.
Scans the deployed host skills directories in the live user profile.
Reads the deployed Codex and Grok configs in the live user profile.

Covers the Windows-only MCP launcher rewrite (Program Files node.exe, %APPDATA%\npm, Hide-Stdio.exe) that Sync-AgentHub.ps1 applies only when $env:OS is Windows_NT; on macOS and Linux the rewrite is intentionally a no-op.
Remove-StaleAgentSessions.ps1 sends files to the Windows Recycle Bin (Microsoft.VisualBasic FileSystem) and scans Windows profile paths; there is no Recycle Bin on Linux or macOS runners.
Invoke-RepoWiseBoundedIndex.ps1 caps the indexer's memory with a Windows Job Object and refuses to run without one; macOS has no equivalent hard per-process-tree memory cap.

The RepoWise host plugin launches its bridge through the Windows py/pyw launcher and Start-RepoWiseShared.ps1 under Windows PowerShell 5.1, and the test inspects ports with Get-NetTCPConnection; the shared RepoWise service is a Windows-host integration.
Update-RepoWise.ps1 manages the RepoWise upgrade as a Windows Task Scheduler job (schtasks.exe) and resolves uv.exe from Windows install locations.
The mobile device lab drives a VMware Workstation macOS guest (vmrun.exe) and the Windows Android emulator from a Windows host.
Exercises VMware Workstation guest bring-up through vmrun.exe on a Windows host.
Syncs a Windows-host checkout into the VMware macOS guest over the mobile lab's SSH configuration, using Windows tar.exe.

Fails on main since #70 (dispatch only to Cursor, Grok and Codex): its dispatch-policy case still expects Cursor Agent, Amp and OpenCode enabled and Codex disabled. Remove this entry once the test matches the new policy.
